19th Birthday
A Heartfelt Unveiling

To My Dearest Riddhi,

Happy 19th Birthday.

Today is all about celebrating you, and I wanted to take a moment, away from all the noise, to tell you, from my heart, just how much you mean to me. Nineteen feels like such a special milestone, and seeing the incredible person you are – strong, kind, brilliant – fills me with so much pride. You have this amazing way of making everything around you brighter, and I feel like the luckiest person in the world to be by your side.

I don't think I say it enough, but I appreciate you more than words can express. You have this incredible gift for understanding me, sometimes without me even needing to speak, and your constant support gives me the courage to be my best self. When I'm with you, everything feels lighter, peaceful, and simply right. You are my absolute favorite person and my safest place.

There are so many things I like about you – your kindness, the way your mind works, the passion you pour into everything you care about. You're beautiful inside and out, but it's your heart, your humor, and your incredible spirit that truly captivate me. I'm always amazed by your strength, your grace, and how effortlessly you bring joy to everyone around you.

As you step into this new year, I want you to know I'm always here, cheering you on louder than anyone. I can't wait to see all the amazing things you'll do, the dreams you'll chase, and how you'll continue to grow. Whatever Nineteen brings, I promise to be right here with you, through every high and every low.

Thank you for choosing me, for liking me, and for just being the extraordinary person you are. I hope your birthday is as beautiful and perfect as you deserve.

Happy Birthday, gorgeous. I like you more than words can say.

Forever & Always Yours, Sarvagya
